text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Minister rules out a second salary increase to government employees. Bahrain gave a general pay rise last month.
- Bahrain Training Institute earmarks 15 million dinars for an expansion project.
- Bahrain to outlaw any company that harms the environment.
- Algerian products fair opened in Bahrain on Tuesday.
- Bahraini, U.S. officials hold talks on military cooperation.
- Bahraini communication minister leaves for Jordan to attend Thursday's Arabsat meeting in Amman.
- Arab Insurance Group will on Wednesday announce plans to double its paid-in capital to $300 million from $150 million.
